scope: Independent source/specification contract and fixtures only. No candidate implementation, hardware access, credentials or paid calls.

layout_locators.product: SH-2 section6.3 product requests/responses; sh2.c ProdIdReq_t/ProdIdResp_t

precise_contract: Product query F9 00 and each F8 response record16B; parse all known batch records. Product version/part/build are software metadata, not definitive hardware marking.
ME query F2, command-sequence,07, P0..P8 with onlyP3=1. Match F1 command07 and echoed command-sequence@3; require successR0@5. Preserve full response, including on-tableR5@10.
Get Feature FE,id; FC17B fields are id@1,flags@2,u16 sensitivity@3,u32 interval@5,u32 batch@9,u32 specific@13, little-endian. No transaction token; unsolicited responses are allowed.
Restore exact saved feature payload by changing FC to FD, retaining bytes1..16. Disabled report is interval0, never infer it from missing response.
Reports07/08/13 are16/12/6B respectively.07 has signedQ9 xyz/bias;08 signedQ14 xyzw;13 class byte4 with byte5 reserved. Common status low2bits and14bit delay are separate.
Relative sensor time is(-signed base + signed rebases + delay)*100us. Keep host receipt separate without HINT. Raw sentinel timebase0x7fffffff cannot support valid absolute time.

The saved official getCalConfigRx helper discards on-tableR5 despite the manual defining it; newer setCalConfigStart usesR6 while manual1.9 reserves it. Raw fields must remain available; do not copy helper loss into diagnostic.
restoration_review_requirements: No BNO055 constructor, executable reset, Initialize, Tare, DCD save/erase, periodic-save configuration or ME configure command. ME07 readback only with exactP3=1.

Inspect mode permits only product/ME/GetFeature queries. Compare mode additionally permits FD only for explicitly selected diagnostic report IDs, with a confirmed before-snapshot for every field changed.

Before compare, snapshot02/05/07/08/13 effective configurations and ME flags. Do not proceed after missing/truncated/nonmatching baseline. Drain stale controls before serial requests; report remaining FC correlation limitation.

Mark each feature dirty before attempting a write; short write or timeout can have effects. Try restore for every dirty feature on signal, parse/write failure and normal exit within a separate bounded cleanup deadline.

Disable newly enabled temporary features first, then restore original active configurations. Query the complete monitored set afterward because related-sensor rates may change. Exact final mismatch means restoration unconfirmed, not success; no automatic reset/retry loop.
If effective original configuration cannot be recreated exactly, preserve raw before/request/after receipts and fail clearly. Never save new calibration as a cleanup action.

No reset/save/erase command preserves original stored DCD from explicit modifications; report changes can still affect ongoing fusion/calibration state. Do not claim bitwise DCD/RAM restoration or reverse elapsed algorithm history.

prior_probe2_reuse.usable: Pinned actual product/control/report bytes and field interpretations; complete known-batch decoder evidence.
prior_probe2_reuse.not_usable_unchanged: Startup calls BNO055 constructor which resets sensor; it enables08/13 without restoring previous configuration, uses old transport and first-report-only presentation. Do not run unchanged.

source_addendum.finding: Heading-accuracy decoding in official SDK is signedQ12. Keep raw bits and do not publish a negative value as a positive unsigned estimate.
